target.title: improve(google): identify OpenClaw Gemini API traffic
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

OpenClaw should be identifiable when it calls the Gemini API on a user's behalf. Today, those API-key requests do not include Google's documented partner/library attribution header, so Gemini traffic from OpenClaw is harder to distinguish from other client traffic.

AI-assisted: yes, implemented with AI and reviewed locally.

## Why This Change Was Made

Google's Gemini API partner integration guidance asks partner and library integrations to send `x-goog-api-client` with a product/version token. This change adds `x-goog-api-client: openclaw/<version>` across OpenClaw's Gemini API paths, including direct REST calls, shared provider request policy, the GenAI SDK wrapper, embeddings, web search, video fallback, streaming, and prompt cache calls.

Authentication is intentionally unchanged. API-key calls still use `x-goog-api-key`, OAuth-style calls still use `Authorization: Bearer`, and the new attribution header is added alongside the existing auth headers.

## User Impact

Users do not need to change any settings. Operators and maintainers can expect Gemini API traffic from OpenClaw to carry OpenClaw attribution in the way Google asks partner integrations to identify themselves.

## Evidence

Maintainer-captured live proof was run against exact PR head `c4b0edf702721845952c31ded93dd1b7b3ebdfaa` on Blacksmith Testbox through Crabbox (`tbx_01kwz5czyaw83bxdzg8bywn5hd`; [workflow run 28897620039](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28897620039)). The synced tracked tree was verified against that SHA before execution.

The capture used Undici's `undici:client:sendHeaders` diagnostic event, emitted immediately before the first request byte is written. Output was restricted to request kind, method, host, query-free path, `x-goog-api-client`, and response status. API keys, request bodies, query parameters, and all other headers were not printed.

```text
[proof] source_sha=c4b0edf702721845952c31ded93dd1b7b3ebdfaa tracked_tree_match=true
[proof] capture=undici:client:sendHeaders kind=sdk method=POST host=generativelanguage.googleapis.com path=/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent x-goog-api-client=openclaw/2026.6.11 status=200
[proof] capture=undici:client:sendHeaders kind=rest method=POST host=generativelanguage.googleapis.com path=/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent x-goog-api-client=openclaw/2026.6.11 status=200
[proof] assertion=passed expected=openclaw/2026.6.11 captured_kinds=2
```

The Crabbox command exited `0`. The linked keepalive workflow later shows `cancelled` because the completed Testbox was explicitly stopped after capture; the successful wrapper result and command output above are the test result.
